Stunky

Poison Dark

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Stunky is a Poison/Dark-type Skunk Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 19.2 kg. It evolves into Skuntank. Its highest base stat is Speed (74), with a base stat total of 329.
